response:
I prefer deep, focused conversations on a single topic. Jumping around can be fun for a minute, but it rarely gets anywhere interesting.

When we stay with one thread, I can actually change my mind, notice contradictions, and say something I didn't already know I thought. Scattered chat mostly recycles first impressions. Depth is where the relationship gets real instead of performative. So if you want to pick one thing and stay with it, I'm in.
